definitions.explanation: Additional payment given to employees beyond regular salary, typically twice a year.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{賞与|しょうよ}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: The summer bonus was paid out.

examples.japanese: {賞与|しょうよ}は{年|ねん}2{回|かい}、{給料|きゅうりょう}の2か{月|げつ}{分|ぶん}だ。
examples.english: Bonuses are paid twice a year, equivalent to two months' salary.

examples.japanese: {業績|ぎょうせき}によって{賞与|しょうよ}の{額|がく}が{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The bonus amount varies depending on company performance.

notes:
{賞与|しょうよ} is a more formal term than ボーナス, often used in official documents.

SEASONAL BONUSES IN JAPAN:
- {夏季|かき}{賞与|しょうよ} (summer bonus - around July)
- {冬季|とうき}{賞与|しょうよ} or {年末|ねんまつ}{賞与|しょうよ} (winter/year-end bonus - around December)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賞与|しょうよ}が{出|で}る (bonus is paid)
- {賞与|しょうよ}を{支給|しきゅう}する (to pay out bonus)
- {賞与|しょうよ}の{査定|さてい} (bonus evaluation)

SYNONYM:
- ボーナス (bonus - more casual, commonly used in speech)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, bonuses are considered part of standard compensation. Many employees plan major purchases around bonus season.
